data.title: Rithm Capital, GreenBarn Investment Group and FarmViewVentures Announce $56.25 Million Sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard in Arlington, Virginia
data.description: A significant commercial real estate transaction was revealed in Arlington, Virginia, as Rithm Capital Corp., GreenBarn Investment Group, and FarmViewVentures jointly announced the successful sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard. The 188,014-square-foot Class A office property located in Arlington’s Ballston submarket was acquired in September 2024 and has been sold for $56.25 million to Piedmont Realty Trust, Inc. This sale signifies the completion of a strategic repositioning effort carried out by the three companies during their ownership of the property.
